changes: original_meaning 大改：现行字段把『淋浴』列入古英语原义，但淋浴义 1851 年才出现（Etymonline 编年）；原义按 scur 的 gloss 改为『一阵雨，暴风』。
semantic_path 重建三站（阵雨 → 约 1400 年『一阵倾泻』扩展 → 1851 年淋浴），替换三站套话。
mechanism_sentence 重写，点明词根的北风义。
evidence: Etymonline: "Old English scur, scura \"a short fall of rain, storm, tempest; fall of missiles or blows; struggle, commotion; breeze,\" from Proto-Germanic *skuraz... from PIE root *kew-(e)ro- \"north, north wind\""

Etymonline: "By Middle English in the general sense of \"a copious supply bestowed\": Of blood, tears, etc., from c. 1400. Of meteors from 1835. Sense of \"bath in which water is poured from above\" is recorded by 1851 (short for shower-bath, itself attested from 1803)."
shower.mechanism_sentence: shower 的老底带着「北风」：古英语 scur 是北风扫来的一阵雨——后来血、泪、流星都能成「阵」；1851 年，连从头顶淋下的洗澡水也成了 shower（它是 shower-bath 的缩略）。

semantic_path.how: 『一阵倾泻』的样子被借走：中古英语里血、泪可以成阵（约 1400 年），1835 年流星也可以成阵（meteor shower）——凡短时密集落下的，都叫 shower。
阵雨搬进了浴室：1851 年 shower 指『水从上方淋下』的洗浴（shower-bath 1803 年先行，shower 为其缩略）——下法与阵雨无异，词库今义『淋浴』即此。

changes: original_meaning 按古英语 scunian 的 gloss 收为「躲开；厌弃」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明该词词义千年一贯与出身未明并存的事实（OED 口径），不编造变化；未明一节已在 disputes 登记。
mechanism_sentence 重写（原句为罗列式）。
evidence: Etymonline: "Middle English shunnen, \"keep out of the way of, avoid (a person or place); refrain from, neglect (a practice or behavior),\" from Old English scunian \"run away from, avoid; abhor, loathe; seek safety by concealment,\" a word of uncertain origin; according to OED not found in other Germanic languages. Perhaps it is ultimately from PIE root *skeu- \"to cover, to hide.\""
Oxford: "Old English scunian 'abhor, shrink back with fear, seek safety from an enemy', of unknown origin."
shun.mechanism_sentence: shun 是古英语 scunian「远远躲开、厌弃」：它的出身至今不明（牛津直说 unknown origin），词义倒是千年一贯——就是「避开」。

semantic_path.how: 这个词的史实恰在『不变』：中古英语 shunnen 与古英语义一脉相承（躲开某人某地、戒绝某事），不像邻词那样分化——来源三家均只登记到『或与遮盖、隐藏的词根有关』的推测为止（Etymonline 引 OED）。

changes: original_meaning 按古英语 scyttan 的 gloss 改为「把门闩插到位」：现行字段堆叠了词根义（『使快速移动』属更深层的 *skeud- 义）与后起分义。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明 14 世纪中泛化到一切『折叠并拢合上』的确切年代，并点明与 shoot 同根。
evidence: Etymonline: "shut (v.) Middle English shitten, sheten, \"close (a door, window, gate, etc.); lock, fasten closed,\" from Old English scyttan \"to put (a bolt) in place so as to fasten a door or gate, bolt, shut to; discharge, pay off,\" from West Germanic *skutjan... from PIE root *skeud- \"to shoot, chase, throw.\""
Etymonline: "The meaning \"to close by folding or bringing together\" is from mid-14c."
Oxford: "Old English scyttan 'put (a bolt) in position to hold fast', of West Germanic origin; related to Dutch schutten 'shut up, obstruct', also to shoot."
shut.mechanism_sentence: shut 的老动作是「插闩」：古英语 scyttan 是把门闩推到位（与 shoot 同根——闩像一根射出去的横木）；14 世纪中起，一切折叠、并拢的「合上」都归了它。

semantic_path.how: 关的对象从大门扩到万物：14 世纪中 shut 添『折叠或并拢而合上』义（书、眼睛、嘴巴都可以 shut）——插闩的动作泛化成一切『使闭合』，词库今义『关闭；合上』即此。

changes: original_meaning 按古英语 sīde 的 gloss 收为「侧面（长的那一面）；胁腹」；词基的『长』义（古英语 sīd『长、宽』）写入 mechanism_sentence。
semantic_path 第二站 how 按 Etymonline 编年（13 世纪中站队义、14 世纪末交易方、15 世纪中方面义）替换套话。
evidence: Etymonline: "side (n.) Old English side \"flanks of a person, the long part or aspect of anything,\" from Proto-Germanic *sīdō..., from adjective *sithas \"long\" (source of Old English sid \"long, broad, spacious,\" Old Norse siðr \"long, hanging down\"), from PIE root *se- \"long; late\""

Etymonline: "The figurative sense of \"position or attitude of a person or set of persons in relation to another\" (as in choose sides, side of the story) is recorded by mid-13c. As \"an aspect\" of anything immaterial (the bright side, etc.), by mid-15c. The meaning \"one of the parties in a transaction\" is from late 14c."
side.mechanism_sentence: side 的老底是「长」：身体长长的那一面就是「侧」；13 世纪起，人站到哪一侧，哪一侧就成了立场上的一「方」，事物也被看出了一个个「方面」。

semantic_path.how: 从身体的侧面转到关系的侧面（比喻）：13 世纪中已见『立场、站队』义（choose sides），14 世纪末指交易的一方，15 世纪中指抽象事物的一个面（the bright side 光明面）——词库今义『边』之外，『一方；方面』都在这一支。
